**Searching for bridging loan stats**

The user seems to be looking for statistics, possibly the latest information, so I’ll need to clarify that. I think starting with an overview of recent UK bridging loan statistics could be helpful. I should focus on authoritative sources like the ASTL and FCA to ensure reliability. It looks like a search is in order to gather the most accurate data for the user. Let's get to it!

**Preparing facts and stats**

I see I only have one web call to make. The user seems to want a summary with citations for all factual claims, but their request is a bit terse. I could ask for clarification, but I can still provide the headline stats while offering deeper insights if needed. It's important to cite every fact with internet-supported sources. I'll also mention regulated bridging and BDLA/Bridging Trends while noting that market definitions can differ. Let's put together some concise bullet points!

Here are some **UK bridging loan statistics** you can use, split by source because the market is measured in different ways:

### 1) FCA regulated bridging loans
These figures cover **regulated bridging loan sales** reported to the FCA, so they are a narrower subset of the total bridging market. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-regulated-bridging-short-term-loans-january-2025?utm_source=openai))

- **2021:** **2,368** sales, total value **£931.8m**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-regulated-bridging-short-term-loans-january-2025?utm_source=openai))
- **2022:** **3,038** sales, total value **£1.278bn**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-regulated-bridging-short-term-loans-january-2025?utm_source=openai))
- **2023:** **3,735** sales, total value **£1.425bn**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-regulated-bridging-short-term-loans-january-2025?utm_source=openai))
- **2024 (Q1–Q3):** **3,043** sales, total value **£1.163bn**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-regulated-bridging-short-term-loans-january-2025?utm_source=openai))
- **2025 (full year):** **4,691** sales, total value **£1.828bn**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-mortgage-bridging-loans-february-2026?utm_source=openai))

That means FCA-regulated bridging volumes rose from **£1.425bn in 2023** to **£1.828bn in 2025**, while sales increased from **3,735** to **4,691** over the same period. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-regulated-bridging-short-term-loans-january-2025?utm_source=openai))

### 2) FCA 2025 breakdowns
For **2025 regulated bridging loans**, the largest loan-value band by number of sales was **£120,001 to under £250,000** with **1,326** sales, while the largest by value was **£250,000 to under £500,000** at **£433.6m**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-mortgage-bridging-loans-february-2026?utm_source=openai))

By region in **2025**, **Central & Greater London** had the highest total value at **£503.0m** from **773** sales. The **South West** had **846** sales worth **£312.8m**, which was the highest sales count among regions listed. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-mortgage-bridging-loans-february-2026?utm_source=openai))

The FCA also reported **second-charge regulated bridge loans** in **2025** at **281** sales worth **£42.2m**. ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-mortgage-bridging-loans-february-2026?utm_source=openai))

### 3) Wider market / industry data
Industry data from the **BDLA** shows a much larger market than the FCA regulated subset, because it covers broader bridging and development lending activity reported by member lenders. ([bridgingandcommercial.co.uk](https://bridgingandcommercial.co.uk/article/21083/bridging-loan-books-surpass-pound10bn?utm_source=openai))

- **Q4 2024:** bridging completions reached a record **£2.3bn**, and total loan books rose to **£10.3bn** for the first time. Applications were **£11.3bn**. ([bridgingandcommercial.co.uk](https://bridgingandcommercial.co.uk/article/21083/bridging-loan-books-surpass-pound10bn?utm_source=openai))
- **Q1 2025:** applications jumped to **£18.34bn** and completions totalled **£2.8bn**, matching the record level cited for **Q4 2024** in that report. ([bridgingandcommercial.co.uk](https://bridgingandcommercial.co.uk/article/21421/bridging-applications-rocket-55-hinting-at-lending-surge-ahead?utm_source=openai))
- **Q1 2026:** completions were **£1.8bn**, applications **£9.9bn**, and total lender loan books **£11.5bn**. Average LTV was **56.64%**. ([bridgingandcommercial.co.uk](https://bridgingandcommercial.co.uk/bdla-data-shows-dip-in-activity-as-completions-fall-to-18bn?utm_source=openai))

### 4) Bridging Trends market indicators
According to **Bridging Trends** data reported in February **2025** for the **2024** market:

- total gross lending was **£822.2m**, just **1% below** the **£831m** historic high recorded in **2023**;  
- average completion time fell from **58 days in 2023** to **47 days in 2024**;  
- average monthly interest rate increased from **0.86%** to **0.88%**; and  
- average LTV was reported at **58%**. ([bridgingandcommercial.co.uk](https://bridgingandcommercial.co.uk/article/21058/bridging-trends-data-shows-market-resilience-and-faster-completion-times-in-2024?utm_source=openai))

### Quick takeaway
If you want a simple headline: **the UK bridging market remained large and active through 2024–2026, with FCA-regulated bridging reaching £1.83bn across 4,691 sales in 2025, while broader BDLA industry data showed quarterly completions as high as £2.8bn and loan books above £11bn by Q1 2026.** ([fca.org.uk](https://www.fca.org.uk/freedom-information/information-mortgage-bridging-loans-february-2026?utm_source=openai))

If you want, I can turn this into:
1. a **table**,  
2. a **short market commentary**, or  
3. **APA/Harvard-style cited notes** for a report.
